rules: PATCH runs only checks impacted by files changed since the trusted checkpoint
CHECKPOINT runs impacted checks plus a small safety net and persists a new checkpoint on PASS
CANDIDATE runs targeted and directly impacted checks plus the candidate safety net; it does not run the full accumulated PRE_EDITOR suite by default
RELEASE runs the full accumulated regression/scenario/profile suite and portable exact-package verification after candidate evidence is coherent
historical regression memories and package rebuilds must not be rerun after every small edit
every run records elapsed time and budget status
